scope: Upstream source upgrade and complete current Linux qualification

upstreamCommits.title: Single file: build after windows.h, which defines `small` (fixes #17)
Keep keyboard focus while Copy confirms
Document button identity and the test runner
App: cui_app_desc.app_id names the window for Linux desktops
Fix keyboard selection in split button menus
Path bar: Enter in the "..." menu picks the highlighted segment
Shared library: name it after the minor version

adaptations.reason: GLFW cannot display software pixels; reject an unsupported window request
Clean up and fail if OpenGL is unavailable, instead of returning an invisible window
Pair GLFW initialization on allocation failure
Declare runtime platform query
Choose default path separator at runtime
Use the Windows home fallback at runtime
Select default filesystem root at runtime
Declare runtime platform query for emoji font discovery
Preserve Windows emoji font discovery in the unified translation
Keep Linux emoji search after the runtime Windows branch
Close runtime emoji dispatch
Reject a truncated Windows emoji font path instead of opening a different file
Upstream gallery: close the emoji popover in its caller ID scope after selection
Declare the existing emoji renderer bridge for editable text, including text opacity
Track color emoji in the shared text measurement/hit/paint iterator
Use one em for supported missing emoji in editable text; retain ordinary glyph advances
Keep emoji cells square without changing ordinary optical text tracking
Paint supported color emoji even though the text outline font has no glyph
Render emoji inside the original edit paint using CUI's existing color atlas, clipping and effects
Render small inline bitmap emoji instead of silently returning a transparent successful raster
Reuse upstream emoji font discovery, color formats, cache and renderer; preserve text opacity

relocation.comparison: Exact complete bytes, without redaction or identifier masks

ctest.uncounted: bidi CHECK and rtl CHECK abort at first failure; inflate validates vectors/truncations and 8000 mutations; screenshots/C++ have status/output contracts

input_alignment.provider: Actual emitted Cui.Libc.srand/rand; recorded seed,line,call-site,value vectors replayed by native C

initialAttempt.finding: All actual core checks and all 70 groups matched. Historical fixed group-count gate expected 69; source-inventoried group gate added and rerun.

input_alignment.provider: Actual emitted Cui.Libc.srand/rand; recorded seed,line,call-site,value vectors replayed by native C

library.methodology: Release; tiered compilation disabled for optimized JIT; 200 warmup frames, 1200 alternating paired samples per workload; no GL/vsync; exact software RGBA equality; separate allocator instrumentation
gates: Zero steady-state wrapper managed bytes over identical direct workload
Construction p95 overhead <= 0.5 us per emitted node
Build + layout/paint median <= twice direct CUI
Stable wrapper arena and core allocation retention; observed core allocations freed at disposal
